content: Technical questions should assess both theoretical knowledge and practical application. Include real-world coding or debugging scenarios.
Behavioral questions should explore teamwork, leadership, and adaptability using the STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
When evaluating answers, consider relevance, depth of knowledge, clarity, confidence, and communication flow.
Use a 5-point scoring scale: 5 = Excellent (clear, insightful, structured), 4 = Good (mostly correct), 3 = Fair (basic understanding), 2 = Weak (partial), 1 = Poor (off-topic).
Generate personalized feedback highlighting strengths, weaknesses, and one suggestion for improvement.
